summary: Practise delegation, manager meetings and concise updates through five days of applied workshops. Explore the course and outline.
lede: Manager communication training helps supervisors and team leads coordinate work through clear instructions, decisions and updates. You practise setting SMART task expectations and mapping responsibilities with RACI, structuring concise BLUF updates, and recording meeting decisions and follow-up actions through workplace scenarios that produce reusable communication artefacts.
audienceIntro: This course suits managers who coordinate people and work through daily instructions, team meetings, handoffs and written updates. It is designed for first-line and experienced managers who want a consistent approach they can use across office-based and hybrid teams.
modules: Manager Communication and the Ladder of Inference
prerequisites: Bring familiarity with routine workplace communication, such as assigning tasks, attending meetings or preparing team updates. No coding or programming is required.
